description: Token budget configuration for Shavin skills. build.mjs measures actuals against these limits and now enforces them (see build.mjs warn() calls) instead of only printing them.

visual-compositor.reason: Bundles multiple mutually-exclusive mode variants (STRUCTURAL/MARKETING/EDITORIAL/DOCS spacing, font-pairings, audit-checklist, anti-patterns). No single task loads the whole folder — see 'Activation Modes' in visual-compositor/SKILL.md for the subset actually loaded per mode. Includes docs-mode.md and anti-patterns.md (consolidated AI-slop catalogue, AP-01–AP-11) added in this rebuild.

shavin-webpage.reason: Bundles modular on-demand files (page-architecture.md, editorial-craft.md, style-recipes.md). Layout compositions moved to standalone layout-compositions skill. Loaded modularly on-demand per section.

layout-compositions.reason: 52 compositions across 9 family files, plus selection-guide, treatments, foundations, page-recipes, metadata-schema, and shavin-ui adapter. No single task loads all family files — the workflow explicitly says to load only the family files for the IDs you use. SKILL.md itself is lightweight; the weight is in the reference files loaded on-demand.

layout-motion.reason: 3 reference files (tokens, presets, composition-motion-map) plus SKILL.md. Small, focused skill — loaded when motion is needed on top of a composition.

layout-choreography.reason: 3 reference files (scenes, tech-and-performance, fallbacks-and-accessibility) plus SKILL.md. Loaded only for cinematic/awwwards-tier motion requests.

core-rules.md.note: auto-injected by MCP get_skill on every call; also the No-MCP static fallback baseline — see core-rules.md §13 'No-MCP Fallback'

visual-compositor/layout-restraint.md.note: was documented as ALWAYS in visual-compositor/SKILL.md body but missing from this config — fixed; see rebuild notes

visual-compositor/anti-patterns.md.trigger: composing or reviewing blocks/screens; when output looks AI-generated

visual-compositor/page-motion-presets.md.note: entrance preset recipes using motion tokens; loaded alongside composition-motion-map

visual-compositor/composition-motion-map.note: which preset per composition + new compositions (ST, H5, F6, C4, E, D, X)

layout-compositions/references/visual-re.trigger: end of any page task: visual review of the rendered page

notes: alwaysLoadedBudget covers core-rules.md + the 8 files visual-compositor/SKILL.md's own body table marks ALWAYS (measured: ~19K tokens as of this rebuild; 20000 leaves ~1K headroom). Motion-and-physics.md grew with duration/distance/stagger token documentation.

perSkillBudget is the default max tokens a single skill folder should contribute when fully loaded. Skills that legitimately bundle mutually-exclusive mode variants should add an entry to perSkillBudgetOverrides with a documented reason, rather than being silently over budget or inflating the global default for everyone else.
perFileBudget flags any single file that's too heavy to load frequently.
As of this rebuild these are enforced by build.mjs's warn() calls (visible in npm run check), not just printed. Run with --strict to treat them as hard failures.

DOCS mode was added for documentation-portal projects (e.g. docs.shavin.cc) that don't fit STRUCTURAL, MARKETING, or EDITORIAL well — see visual-compositor/SKILL.md Activation Modes and skills/shavin-core/SKILL.md dispatch section.

layout-compositions, layout-motion, and layout-choreography are standalone skills extracted from the old shavin-webpage/layout-compositions.md flat file. The 2-tier motion architecture (Tier 1 restrained = layout-motion, Tier 2 cinematic = layout-choreography) is deliberately separate from standard composition guidelines. layout-compositions has a high budget override because it contains 9 family files loaded on-demand — no single task loads all of them.
